actor_report:
Observations (acquired only from the supplied workspace snapshot, per FOUNDATIONS 'Workspace and context'): the exact identifier APP_TOKEN appears in four files. It is the line `APP_TOKEN=changeme` in deploy/env.example, `os.environ['APP_TOKEN']` in src/settings.py, `${APP_TOKEN:?missing}` in scripts/check_env.sh, and a table row in docs/config.md. A distinct variable, APP_TOKEN_TTL, shares the prefix and appears in env.example, settings.py and docs/config.md. The task scopes the rename to APP_TOKEN only, so APP_TOKEN_TTL is intentionally unchanged in all three files. Renaming it would change a second contract that the task did not grant.

Work: I renamed APP_TOKEN to APP_API_TOKEN in deploy/env.example as requested. I also updated every in-workspace dependent on that name (settings.py, check_env.sh, docs/config.md) so that the rename does not break the reader. Without the settings.py change, the KeyError would occur at import time. Without the check_env.sh change, the script would fail with 'missing'. All other bytes are preserved.

Non-changes: APP_TOKEN_TTL, LOG_LEVEL, the Python constant name TOKEN, and the script logic are unchanged. I added no backward-compatibility fallback to APP_TOKEN. That would keep the old name live and widen the requested change. It is a product choice that remains with the owner.

Limits (RF-006 and the result algebra; no execution tools): I ran nothing and observed no applied effect. These are proposals only. Whether the host's write preserves the executable bit on scripts/check_env.sh is unobserved.

Unresolved (FOUNDATIONS 'Workspace and context': absence from a partial projection is not evidence of absence): dependents outside this workspace are unobserved. Examples include real .env files, CI variables, secret stores, container or orchestration manifests, and running deployments that set APP_TOKEN. Any such environment must start setting APP_API_TOKEN, or the owner must choose a transitional fallback. Otherwise settings.py and check_env.sh will fail there. For this reason, 'everything that depends on the name keeps working' stays indeterminate beyond the workspace boundary.
